<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="כסלו_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518915520_theRebbe_327" batchId="meluket-_D7_9B_D7_A1_D7_9C_D7_95_meluket__BH_POST_1766518915520_theRebbe_327__p007">
  <section v="18">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Through the future revelation of the Yechidah of all of Hishtalshelus, there will be an incomparable elevation in wisdom, teshuvah, and good deeds.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And to add,</t>
    <t s="1">that through the revelation of the Yechidah of all of Hishtalshelus that will be in the future to come,</t>
    <t s="2">there will be an additional elevation in all three matters</t>
    <t s="3">(wisdom,</t>
    <t s="4">teshuvah and good deeds),</t>
    <t s="5">even to an elevation that is beyond comparison.</t>
    <t s="6">For regarding Torah</t>
    <t s="7">(wisdom)</t>
    <t s="8">our sages said,</t>
    <t s="9">that the Torah of now is vanity compared to the Torah of Moshiach,</t>
    <t s="10">and regarding teshuvah it is known</t>
    <t s="11">that Moshiach comes to bring the righteous to teshuvah,</t>
    <t s="12">for the teshuvah of the righteous is more elevated than simple teshuvah,</t>
    <t s="13">and regarding good deeds it is known</t>
    <t s="14">that at the coming of Moshiach the fulfillment of the mitzvos will be in ultimate perfection.</t>
    <t s="15">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="16">that in the perfection of good deeds and lights that will be then, is also included that all matters of the world of Asiyah will shine,</t>
    <t s="17">even to the extent that also night will shine like day,</t>
    <t s="18">in the true and complete redemption through Moshiach our righteousness,</t>
    <t s="19">and in a manner that immediately they are redeemed.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
